Module.Name: VULNERABLE_FORM
Module.DataBlock:
<Trigger Name="WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM" TriggerText="
      BEGIN
        -- OFRM-CLNT-001: Client-side only validation
        IF :EMPLOYEES.SALARY IS NULL THEN
          MESSAGE('Salary cannot be null');
          RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
        END IF;

        IF :EMPLOYEES.SALARY < 0 THEN
          MESSAGE('Salary must be positive');
          RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
        END IF;
      END;
    "/>

Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED

FormTrigger.Name: WHEN-NEW-FORM-INSTANCE
ON-LOGON
